data.name: Ravenhill: Initiation
data.detailed_description:
"I said things I can never take back..."

Three days ago, Ethan stormed out of their apartment and accepted a routine work assignment in the Appalachian wilderness of Ravenhill Valley. He was sent to retrieve archived survey files from an old ranger kiosk, completely unaware of what lay ahead. He never returned.

The entire valley has been strictly quarantined and sealed by the Federal Agency of Anomalous Threats following decades of unexplained vanishings, bizarre acoustic reports, psychological distortions and reports of reality itself fracturing. When the local police outright refuse to step foot across the restricted boundary, Hannah is driven by pure worry, love, and overwhelming guilt to enter the fog-bound woods alone.

As she moves deeper into the valley toward Cryptid Lake, she realizes the wilderness is alive, ancient, and deeply hostile. Whispers in the trees speak of forbidden Navajo traditions, skin-shifting predators, and a malevolent, starving entity bound to the soil that hungers for human remorse. To find Ethan, Hannah must confront not only the shifting dimensions of the valley, but the darkest secrets buried within her own heart.

RAVENHILL: INITIATION is a cinematic, story-driven psychological horror experience built around relentless tension, surreal environmental decay, and deep emotional dread.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Cinematic Story-Driven Experience: 
    Immerse yourself in a deeply personal narrative brought to life through rich visual storytelling, realistic atmospheric lighting, and high-fidelity environmental design. Explore dense Appalachian woods, rusted trail kiosk stations, and forgotten residential streets wrapped in heavy, unnatural fog.

  • An Ever-Shifting Reality: 
    Reality in Ravenhill is far from static. Step across the threshold into The Beyond, an ever-changing nightmare dimension where geometry shifts and time distorts.

  • Ancient Folktales and Acoustic Dread: 
    The terror of Ravenhill feeds on memory and ancient lore. Rooted in whispers of Skinwalkers and starving primordial beasts, the entity lurking in the shadows weaponizes past arguments, familiar voices, and psychological trauma, distorting spatial audio to strip you of your sanity as you search for the truth.

  • Tense Survival and Evasion: 
    Survive encounters with unnatural, shape-shifting horrors. Stealthily navigate the rustling grass of shifting voids, rely on audio cues to avoid unseen stalkers, and endure heart-pounding high-speed chases through the storm.

  • Immersive Environmental Exploration: 
    Inspect detailed 1990s environments, solve intricate environmental puzzles, restore long-abandoned power systems, and piece together audio logs left behind by missing rangers, agency personnel, and past residents.

  • An Emotional Story of Guilt and Betrayal: 
    Uncover a raw narrative about love, regret, and the hidden history of Cryptid Lake. Discover why Ethan was lured into the valley under the guise of work and what ancient force awaits at the peak of Amburg House.

MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION

The content of this game may not be suitable for all ages. It includes flashing lights, gore, disturbing imagery, and depictions of psychological trauma and PTSD.

data.short_description: After a bitter argument with Hannah, Ethan vanishes while auditing files in quarantined Ravenhill Valley. When police refuse to enter the restricted zone, Hannah ventures into the fog-drenched woods to find her boyfriend. What she uncovers is an ancient threat and an ever-shifting nightmare reality.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Targeted for 1080p @ 30–40 FPS on Low/Medium settings with DLSS/FSR Quality enabled.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-13700K / AMD Ryzen 7 7700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 4070ti / AMD Radeon RX 7900XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Targeted for 1440p / 1600p @ 60 FPS on High settings with DLSS / FSR Quality Mode enabled. (Native 4K Cinematic Ultra rendering targets enthusiast hardware like the RTX 5080 / 5090).
